events.sql:
SELECT
    HubRegistry AS "Hub Registry ID",
    HubUtilPct AS "Calculated Utilization Value",
    CASE
        WHEN HubUtilPct > 5 THEN 'High Utilization'
        WHEN HubUtilPct BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 'Moderate Utilization'
        WHEN HubUtilPct < 2 THEN 'Low Utilization'
    END AS "Resource Utilization Classification"
FROM
    DistributionHubs
ORDER BY
    HubUtilPct DESC;
